budget_cap_note: FROZEN 2026-11-09 for T042 live campaign (codex-api driver). Pay-as-you-go on Sam's OpenAI account: Codex CLI via the official OpenAI API, model gpt-6-luna, reasoning effort low. Sam authorised this route 2026-11-09 ~19:54 GMT ('全部用luna low'). Expected spend ~$10-16 for all 480 attempts (pilot 48 + confirmation 432) at Luna Standard rates ($0.10 input / $0.01 cached input / $0.125 cache write / $0.50 output per 1M tokens), measured from the bridge pilot rerun usage (~315k tokens/attempt, 99% input). Cap $25 gives headroom for long attempts and reasoning tokens; if projected spend approaches the cap, the run stops and reports instead of continuing. Auth is Codex CLI's own ~/.codex/auth.json; the key is never read, printed or copied by any tooling, and no credential is stored in this repo.
driver_note: Codex CLI 0.164.0, /opt/hatch-image/bin/codex, official OpenAI API (api.openai.com, Responses API). Driver mode selected by env TURNKEEP_CODEX_MODE=official (benchmarks/live/codex_driver.py); no bridge base URL, no bridge key in this mode.
endpoint_note: Official OpenAI API. No local proxy: codex talks to api.openai.com directly (WebSocket transport falls back to HTTPS through the sandbox proxy; verified in smoke test 2026-11-09 ~22:52 GMT).
model_note: GPT-6 Luna, reasoning effort low. Frozen model ID + effort for the whole campaign; a model change requires a new campaign version. Provider does NOT support caller-side seed/temperature: repetition uses seeds 11/29/47 as repetition indices only, recorded, never claimed as reproducible sampling.
